newsitem.title: UK: Glaxo gains after bullish drug trial news.
newsitem.headline: Glaxo gains after bullish drug trial news.

text.p: Glaxo Plc shares built on early gains on Thursday, posting a rise of 21-1/2p to 1,110p, after upbeat news about Phase 111 trials of its lamivudine drug, pharmaceutical analysts said.
Glaxo said the trial was "extremely encouraging".
"This is the first really definitive trial for lamivudine," said BZW's Steve Plag.

"It's a well-structured study with a well-targeted patient group and hard statistical end points. It's always important to be careful when forecasting a product like this. We have to get a clear picture of the product's utility and possibilites of resistance developing. However, the evidence is building that lamivudine could be a major product for the group," he said.

Analysts forecast lamivudine, which treats chronically affected hepatitis B sufferers, could bring yearly sales of at least $300-500 million from launch. Analsyts said the drug is expected to be launched in the Far East at the end of this year.
